learning_outcomes.text: The student knows the most important assemblies of a vehicle.
The student knows and understands the functionality and interaction of the individual components.
The student knows the basics for component dimensioning.
The student knows and understands the procedures for developing a vehicle.
The student knows and understands the technical specifics that play a role in the development process.
The student is aware of the boundary conditions that must be observed, e.g., due to legislation.
The student is able to analyze and evaluate vehicle concepts and to competently participate in the development of vehicles.

syllabus_topics: Foundations for the development, design, production and operation of motor vehicles
Primary important aggregates: engine, transmission, drivetrain, chassis and auxiliary aggregates
Technical facilities for safer and easier operation
Interior design for an optimal working environment for the user
Focus on passenger cars and commercial vehicles for road use
assessment_rules: The module examination consists of partial examinations for the chosen courses of the module, which collectively fulfill the minimum ECTS requirements. The assessment is described for each course within this module. The number, form, and scope of assessments may vary depending on the individual choice of partial achievements. For oral examinations: approx. 5 minutes per ECTS point. A maximum of 4 ECTS may be acquired through internships. The overall grade for the module is formed from the ECTS-weighted grades of the partial examinations and truncated after the first decimal place.
